test_average_network_fictitious_play: test the AverageNetworkFictitiousPlay class by loading an MFG game and running training iterations with a DQN best-response agent
create_dqn_best_response_agent: create a DQN agent as best-response player for fictitious play with configurable hidden layers, learning rate, and replay buffer
build_mfg_environment: build an MFG rl_environment with a uniform random distribution policy and specified population index
run_fictitious_play_iterations: run fictitious play iterations by calling iteration() after training episodes with configurable episodes per iteration
compute_nash_convergence: compute Nash convexity using NashConv on the average network fictitious play policy to verify convergence
